violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: several foods (soups, beans, Tzatziki, hummus)prepared on site and held more than 24 hours in the walk-in were not date marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. The EHS explained the date marking requirement to the PIC. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: several large containers of food ingredients were not labeled. Several squeeze bottles of sauces/condiments were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months. NILE RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 07/08/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Handled Single-Service/Use Items Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped knives, forks, or spoons were not stored with the handles facing one direction.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. The PIC rearranged the utensils during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: There is a hose connected to the mop sink and the hose hangs into the sink, which is not permitted.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. Cut the hose shorter so that it does not extend into the sink, or remove it. The manager moved the hose from the sink during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: A direct connection exists between the drain line of the sanitizing basin of the 3-compartment sink and the sewer line. Air breaks were installed after the pre opening inspection, but they leaked so the connections were covered with duct tape, creating another direct connection.
violations.corrective_action: A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed. The PIC removed the tape during today’s inspection. The drains are scheduled to be repaired next week so they no longer leak.
